text:
Maya Chen: morning — after our IdP connector rotation at 08:10, I can no longer change project settings or open the billing tab for ACME-prod. Clicking Save returns a 403 and UI says 'action not permitted'. :frowning:
Devon Patel: hey Maya, can you confirm if this is only you or others in the project see it too? any changes to group mappings on the IdP? :eyes:
Maya Chen: I'm the only one who tried; my role is Project Admin. IdP team changed the 'roles' attribute mapping to trimmed values (they strip domain suffixes). No one else tried yet, but project owners can't open billing either when I asked one to check.
Support Bot: Ticket created: S-5237 — channeling to platform and auth teams.
Luca Moretti: pinging platform — this sounds like the token payload lost the canonical role claim after the connector change. Maya, can you paste the decoded ID token or the introspection output (redact PII)?
Maya Chen: here's the minimal dump: ```{
  "sub": "user:maya",
  "email": "mchen@acme.com",
  "roles": ["proj-admin"],  // used to be "project-admin@acme.com"
  "exp": 1700000000
}```
Priya Singh: thanks. Platform note: our console authorizer expects exact role strings with org/project suffixes for inherited bindings. Trimming the suffix will fail the role-matching check and result in 403. This is different from the more common missing-claim fail.
Devon Patel: ok, two options: 1) IdP revert mapping to include full role claim (recommended), or 2) temporary server-side compatibility: run a one-off role-resolve job to rehydrate claims for active sessions and resync membership cache.
Maya Chen: we need a quick workaround; can you tell me how to escalate so we don't block deploys?
Luca Moretti: short-term workaround: use CLI to fetch effective roles and call the admin API to rebind you: 
```bash
# fetch effective roles
redwoodctl auth whoami --token $TOKEN --json
# grant temporary project-admin by admin svc token
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_SVC_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/123/projects/456/roles/assign \
  -d '{"member":"mchen@acme.com","role":"project-admin@acme.com"}'
```
Devon Patel: note: admin svc token route requires org-admin privileges; if you don't have that, Support can perform a manual rebind for S-5237 once we verify identity.
Priya Singh: engineering follow-up: we're tracking a bug where the authorizer does strict string equality on roles and doesn't normalize known trimmed forms. I'll file an internal ticket to add a normalization layer and a feature flag to accept legacy claims.
Maya Chen: thanks. I tried the CLI whoami and the roles array shows "proj-admin" (no suffix). Support — please proceed with manual rebind.
Support Bot: S-5237 assigned to Support Tier 2. Requested proof of identity. :white_check_mark:
Devon Patel: for postmortem, we should also add a diagnostic endpoint that shows effective bindings for a user id so customers can quickly see mismatch causes without having to surface tokens.
Luca Moretti: agreed. I've added a note to the ticket: add diagnostic endpoint + normalize layer + rollout plan.
Maya Chen: Support completed manual rebind and I can now access billing and save project settings. Follow-up: will you notify IdP team to revert mapping?
Priya Singh: yes, we've asked IdP to restore the previous mapping format. We'll keep the feature flag disabled until normalization is deployed.
Devon Patel: recording action items: (1) Support manual rebind done, (2) Platform add normalization + diag endpoint (ETA 2 weeks), (3) Customer comms to IdP team and guidance doc about role claim formats.
Maya Chen: closing loop — all good now, thanks team :tada:
